dimensions.contract: Preserve existing component proportions and responsive recipe constraints across materials.
Exact CSS family strings are handed off; preserve existing Figma fonts where matching Klic families are unavailable. Material selection does not change typography.
Blue action, selection, progress and success; neutral surfaces. Contrast requires rendered context validation and is not certified by token presence.
Existing auto-layout, alignment, responsive composition and reading order remain component contracts; material does not change layout.
Preserve existing grouping and density across materials.

Six surface roles select Flat, Glass, Solid Glass or Liquid Glass. Dense content remains opaque. CSS tint, blur and rim approximate optics; native Figma GLASS refraction is not claimed equivalent. Opaque fallbacks remain recipe behavior.
Keyboard, tab order, semantic status, focus, reduced motion and reduced transparency remain explicit behavior contracts. Material selection does not alter them; runtime refraction is excluded.
